name: Hong Kong 🇭🇰
subtitle: Dim sum, 3-star temples, and cha chaan teng culture
items: The Chairman (Central, Danny Yip — Modern Cantonese, Asia's 50 Best Top 10, steamed flower crab is the dish)
Lung King Heen (Four Seasons, Chan Yan Tak, 3-star — first Chinese restaurant in the world to earn three Michelin stars)
Tim Ho Wan (multiple, cheapest Michelin meal in the world — the baked BBQ pork buns)
Amber (Landmark Mandarin, Richard Ekkebus, 2-star — the seafood-forward French)
8 1/2 Otto e Mezzo Bombana (Landmark, Umberto Bombana, 3-star — finest Italian in Asia)
Duddell's (Central, contemporary Cantonese + art gallery)
Mott 32 (Standard Chartered Bank building basement, Malcolm Wood — the most beautiful Chinese restaurant anywhere)
Yung Kee Restaurant (Central, since 1942 — roast goose, the Hong Kong institution)
Ho Lee Fook (Central, Jowett Yu, Modern Chinese — natural wine + dumplings + noodles)
Neighborhood (Sheung Wan, David Lai, French with heart)
Australia Dairy Company (Jordan, Kowloon — scrambled egg toast + milk tea, 7am queue, 30-min max)
Tai Cheong Bakery (Central, legendary egg tarts — warrant of HM the Queen)
Capital Café (multiple, cha chaan teng experience — macaroni in broth, milk tea, pineapple bun)
Dim dim sum (multiple, modern dim sum, beautiful baskets)
Yat Lok (Central, 1-star roast goose rice — Anthony Bourdain's last Hong Kong meal)
Luk Yu Tea House (Central, since 1933 — the ultimate old Hong Kong dim sum institution)
Ser Wong Fun (Central, snake soup — winter only, 1930s)
Ronin (Gough St, natural wine + Japanese snacks)
Type (Wan Chai, natural wine)
Aberdeen Street Social (Central, Jason Atherton)
